newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Oct 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Oct 3.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Oct 3:
WASHINGTON - Rupert Murdoch's 24-hour Fox News Channel makes its debut Monday in cable TV household across the country.
WASHINGTON - Baltimore dockworkers rejected a local labour agreement that management had argued was critical to the port retaining its share of East Coast shipping.
WASHINGTON - Electronics marketers bet that consumers will go for wallet-sized two-way radios that let you keep in touch over short distances.
WASHINGTON - The IMF and World Bank formally launched an initiative they would have considered heretical a few years ago - a plan to offer debt relief to about 20 of the world's poorest countries.
WASHINGTON - U.S. carmakers continue to take too long to get new products to showrooms and are moving too slowly to develop potentially lucrative markets, a panel of automotive experts said.
